pack: Consolidated Postfiatd Post-Quantum Security Evaluation Pack
scale: 0-5 per surface (0 = no protection and no design; 5 = migrated, measured, and operated). Dimensions: measurement completeness, in-tree support, migration design, operational readiness. Overall is the mean of the five surface scores.

surfaces.rationale: Benchmarks are complete and re-run fresh in this pack (ML-DSA-44 verify 27,521.9/s; SLH-DSA-128f 897.5/s; sizes verified against FIPS 204/205 and liboqs headers). Zero PQ code exists in the pinned tree; the dual-signature migration design (PFQS v1 envelope, docs/memos/04-release-signing.md) is fully specified, but no operator procedure exists yet.

Validation signatures are secp256k1-only by an explicit handshake check (Handshake.cpp:294); the single verification entry point makes extension easy but is also a single point of failure. No PQ validation format has been designed; key handling for PQ keys does not exist.

Peer TLS is anonymous by code (verify_none both ends) and the hybrid KEM design is fully specified with a byte-exact wire format and fresh measurements (hybrid handshake 170.17/183.13/206.37 us). No ML-KEM exists in the TLS stack and no version floor is set, so nothing can be switched on today.

The worst surface: releases and images are published unsigned under mutable tags, with signing explicitly deferred. Measurement is complete and the PFQS v1 hybrid envelope (2,492 B, verify 5,051.9/s) is fully specified, but there are no keys, no rotation procedure, and no rollback protection. Nothing here is operated at all.

The best surface: the mechanism exists, is measured live (101 amendments, 64 enabled / 37 disabled; thresholds 204/256 pre-fix and 67/100 post-fix verified in-tree), and the lifecycle model is simulated. The gap is observability, not mechanism: vote counts are admin-only and the vote-tracking amendment is itself disabled.

overall_note: Mean of the five surface scores (2+1+1+0+2)/5 = 1.2. The program is measurement-complete and migration-not-started: every number needed to plan the migration has been measured, but no surface has any PQ protection in production.
single_most_valuable_fix: Stage S0 release signing (Ed25519 signature + SHA-256 checksum file + verifier script on every release, images pinned by digest). It closes the two highest-exploitability findings (C-F01, C-F02) at near-zero cost and no protocol change, and it is the prerequisite for every later hybrid stage: without signed releases, a signed hybrid envelope has nothing trustworthy to attach to.
second_most_valuable_fix: Authenticate /api/tasks (C-C01): a one-line authorization check on a public endpoint that currently returns task JSON to any unauthenticated caller.
